result_summary.title: Self-Service Hub APAC: Duplicate accounts and stuck syncs impacting 27 users
result_summary.description: Users in the APAC production environment are reporting duplicate accounts being created within the Self-Service Hub. Furthermore, the synchronization process for these users seems to be stuck, preventing account updates from propagating. It is unclear whether the issue originates in the Hub itself or potentially in the underlying link handling, as the behavior is consistent across affected users.
